days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Eremo dei Calomini
stops.detail: The larger of the two is the Hermitage of Calomini, in the Municipality of Fabbriche di Vergemoli, while the other is the hermitage of San Viano, located a short distance from Vagli Sopra.

stops.name: lago di Vagli
stops.detail: Lake Vagli, the largest one which, at its maximum level, has a capacity of 36 million cubic meters.

days.title: Versilia Peaks and Subterranean Wonders
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Antro del Corchia
stops.detail: The Corchia Antro, a cave open to the public and recently equipped for visits, is the most extensive cave in Italy and is located on Mount Corchia on the Versilia side.

stops.name: Monte Forato
stops.detail: Located on the southern slope of Mount Sumbra are two natural rarities: the great natural arch of Monte Forato and the "giants' kettles" (glacial potholes).

stops.name: Parco Nazionale della Pace di Sant'Anna di Stazzema
stops.detail: There are also testimonies of the Gothic Line, of the partisan struggles and of the Second World War, such as the National Peace Park of Sant'Anna di Stazzema and the Resistance Park at Monte Brugiana.
